battle.name: 亞拉里克一世第二次入侵意大利
battle.theater: 羅馬城郊與朱利安阿爾卑斯山口
battle.brief: 公元四〇八年秋，亞拉里克率西哥特聯軍自朱利安阿爾卑斯山越境入意大利，繞過沼澤中的拉文納直逼羅馬，九月在城郊合圍，以斷糧代替攻城，逼元老院繳出五千磅黃金買取解圍。卡面這件亞述長弓並未出現在戰場，它是年代卡：五世紀義大利真正使用的弓，是哥特與匈人馬背上的短型複合反曲弓。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰雙方，一邊是亞拉里克一世率領的西哥特聯軍，另一邊是西羅馬帝國皇帝霍諾留斯名下的朝廷與殘餘軍力，戰場在義大利本土，最後落在羅馬城下。哥特一方並非單一民族：亞拉里克所部以西哥特人為主，聯軍中混有東哥特人、赫魯利人與匈人騎兵，以及羅馬莊園與城市中被釋出的哥特奴隸、前聯軍的家屬與獲釋的戰俘。這批依附者是在斯提里科被殺之後才成批湧入軍中的，亞拉里克因此得以在數月之內把一支數萬人的部隊集結起來，其行軍與補給全靠擄掠與地方供應。羅馬一方的指揮體系在衝突前夜已經斷裂：西部軍權原由總司令斯提里科掌握，他以蠻族聯隊駐防並以現金贖買維持邊境；公元四〇八年八月他在拉文納附近遭政變殺害後，執政官奧利姆庇烏斯掌控朝政，隨即清洗聯軍家眷並封鎖將領與皇帝的去路。原有的野戰主力、二十個游戍兵團與邊境雇傭兵在恐懼中星散，羅馬城實際上只剩城防部隊、城樓弩砲與民兵。
countriesEn: The two sides in this war were the Visigothic confederacy under Alaric I on one hand and, on the other, the court and the residual forces of the Western Roman Empire under the emperor Honorius; the fighting took place on the Italian peninsula and ended before the walls of Rome. The Gothic side was not a single people. Alaric's host was led by Visigoths, and the confederacy also contained Ostrogoths, Heruli and Hunnic horsemen, together with Gothic slaves freed from Roman estates and cities, the families of former federate soldiers and released prisoners of war. These dependants came over in large numbers only after Stilicho was killed, and they allowed Alaric to assemble a force of tens of thousands within a few months, a host whose marching and supply depended entirely on plunder and on whatever the country could provide. The Roman command system had already broken apart on the eve of the conflict. Western military power had belonged to the magister militum Stilicho, who held the frontier with barbarian federate units and kept it quiet with cash payments; after his murder near Ravenna in August 408, the praetorian prefect Olympius took control of the court, purged the families of the federates, and cut the generals off from the emperor. The field army, the twenty gutter cohorts and the frontier auxiliaries scattered in fear, and what remained of Rome's military strength was the garrison of the city, the ballistae on the towers and the citizen militia.
people: 留下姓名的關鍵人物多到可以串起整個西羅馬晚期的政治。亞拉里克一世是西哥特王，也是這場入侵的指揮者，他要的不只是錢，而是羅馬承認他的部眾為國家軍隊並按期支付經費，兩次被拒之後才再引兵入意大利。西部總司令斯提里科是羅馬唯一能壓住邊境的人，他兩度在波倫蒂亞與維羅納擊退亞拉里克，也兩度放走對方；公元四〇八年他在策劃讓亞拉里克遠征高盧時被宮廷政變殺害，他的死直接引爆了第二次入侵。執政官奧利姆庇烏斯是政變推手，他清洗聯軍家眷，隨即在朝廷孤立無援。皇帝霍諾留斯自幼被安置在拉文納、遠離前線，是皇帝而無兵權，他每一步都得看執政官與宮廷的臉色。將領薩魯斯出身哥特，在西羅馬軍中效命，政變之夜襲殺同營的匈人部隊，日後又攻擊亞拉里克部眾，兩面樹敵。普里斯庫斯·阿塔盧斯是四〇九年被亞拉里克另立的西羅馬皇帝，卻不肯安分守己，反而使非洲的糧源斷送；非洲總督赫拉克利安努斯扣住稅款不發，司庫歐凱里烏斯奉命索款時殺了總督、帶走錢財卻未分與亞拉里克，成為談判破裂的導火線。執達官尤瑟比烏斯則是少數真正在羅馬與亞拉里克之間談成條件的人。
peopleEn: Enough people are named in this war to string together the whole politics of the late Western Empire. Alaric I, king of the Visigoths, commanded the invasion; what he wanted was not merely money but Roman recognition of his followers as a national army and the punctual payment of their subsidies, and it was only after being refused twice that he led his men back into Italy. Stilicho, magister militum of the West, was the only Roman who could hold the frontier: he defeated Alaric at Pollentia and again at Verona, and twice let him go; in 408 he was killed in a court coup while planning to send Alaric campaigning into Gaul, and his death triggered the second invasion. The praetorian prefect Olympius drove the coup, purged the families of the federates and then found himself isolated at court. The emperor Honorius had been placed at Ravenna from childhood, far from the front, an emperor without troops, and every move he made had to take the colour of the prefect and the palace. Sarus, a Goth serving in the Roman army, slaughtered the Hunnic detachment billeted alongside him on the night of the coup and later struck at Alaric's men, making enemies on both sides. Priscus Attalus was the western emperor proclaimed by Alaric in 409, but he would not stay in his place and instead let the grain supply of Africa slip away. Heraclianus, the count of Africa, held back the tax money, and the quaestor Eucherius, sent to fetch it, killed the count and carried off the treasure without giving Alaric his share, which became the trigger for the breakdown of the negotiations. Eusebius, the quaestor who did conduct the talks, was one of the few who actually settled terms with Alaric.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長弓，學名亞述角弓，是西元前八至七世紀兩河流域的長型複合弓，木質弓身以角與筋背貼，弓梢反曲，配蘆桿箭與青銅或鐵鏃；它早就在西方退出軍備數百年，四〇八年的義大利戰場上沒有任何一支軍隊使用這種弓，所以這是一張年代卡，用來標示弓在軍事史上的起點，而非參戰裝備。真正與這場戰爭相關的弓，是哥特與匈人攜帶的短型複合反曲弓：角、筋與木製成，長約六十至七十公分，弓梢明顯內彎，可以在馬背上拉開，箭短而輕，弓兵多不披甲，靠騎射與迂迴騷擾敵後。羅馬方面的野戰投射兵種在四世紀末已大幅萎縮，步兵靠長矛（pilum）、短劍與長劍（spatha）以及橢圓大盾（scutum）作戰，弓兵幾乎退出野戰序列，弩砲（ballista）成為重要的機械投射兵器，車載弩砲也還留在軍中，卻已經沒有「車上射手」這種人兵合一的搭配。亞述弓兵在車上射、車兵靠弓兵開路的組合，在晚期羅馬只剩空殼：羅馬的戰車兵在五世紀初被裁撤，車上原本的射手由機械取代。守城的手段則是弩砲、投石與繩梯，而哥特人此戰幾乎不用攻城塔，靠封鎖與饑荒取勝。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Assyrian bow, an angular composite bow of the seventh and eighth centuries BC in Mesopotamia: a wooden body backed with horn and sinew, the tips recurving, fired with reed arrows carrying bronze or iron heads. It had left European service several centuries before, and no army present in Italy in 408 used anything of that kind, so this is an era card marking the starting point of the bow in military history rather than a piece of equipment that fought. The bow actually connected with this war was the short composite recurved bow carried by Goths and Huns: horn, sinew and wood, roughly sixty to seventy centimetres long, with markedly recurved tips that could be drawn from the saddle; the arrows were short and light, the archers mostly unarmoured, and they worked by mounted shooting and by shooting around the flanks. In the Roman army the missile troops proper had shrunk sharply by the end of the fourth century. Infantry fought with the pilum, the short sword, the spatha and the oval scutum, and the bow had almost vanished from the line of battle, while the ballista had become the important mechanical missile engine; even the carroballista was still kept in the army, but the combination of man and bow on a vehicle was long gone. The Assyrian pairing of a shooting archer on the chariot with the charioteer following behind the archers survived in the late Roman army only as an empty form: the Roman chariot troops were abolished at the beginning of the fifth century and the archer on the platform was replaced by a machine. The means of defence lay in ballistae, stone-throwers and rope ladders, while the Goths in this campaign used almost no siege towers at all and won by blockade and hunger.
tactics: 亞拉里克的第二次入侵走的是一條已經鋪好的路：公元四〇八年秋，他率軍自朱利安阿爾卑斯山的東段越過山界，沿斯提里科曾為聯軍安排的道路與補給線下來，避開沼澤環繞而有海港防守的拉文納，直取羅馬。進入義大利後他沒有分兵劫掠，而是把主力壓向首都，於九月在羅馬城郊紮營，扼住通往奧斯蒂亞港的鹽路與大道，斷絕非洲與西西里運來的糧食；他不攻城，也不大打，只讓包圍圈慢慢收緊，以饑荒代替刀兵。城內守軍靠城樓上的弩砲控制城外道路，零星騎兵出城襲擾運糧隊伍，但羅馬在野戰上已無可信賴的師團，於是談判取代會戰。元老院的使者面對「這不是和平，而是奴役的契約」的局面，最後接受的條件是五千磅黃金與三萬磅白銀等巨額實物，外加一批人質；圍解之後亞拉里克退往北義大利，四〇九年再圍羅馬，另立傀儡皇帝，直至四一〇年八月二十四日拂曉同時猛攻數座城門、城內又有內應接應，城破之後連日洗劫。對照卡面：亞述的射手開路、車兵跟進屬正面突破的邏輯，五世紀的義大利圍城卻是封鎖與消耗的邏輯，弓在其中的作用主要在野戰騷擾與劫掠，攻城本身則交給弩砲與封鎖。
tacticsEn: Alaric's second invasion followed a road that had already been prepared. In the autumn of 408 he led his host across the eastern section of the Julian Alps, descending by the route and the supply arrangements that Stilicho had once made for the federates, bypassing Ravenna with its marshes and its guarded harbour, and pressing straight for Rome. Once in Italy he did not disperse his men to plunder but drove the main body against the capital, camping outside the city in September and seizing the salt road and the highway to the harbour of Ostia, so as to cut off the grain coming from Africa and Sicily. He did not storm the walls and he did not fight a battle; he simply let the ring of encirclement tighten, using hunger in place of the sword. The defenders relied on the ballistae of the towers to control the roads outside, and small bodies of cavalry rode out to harry the grain convoys, but Rome had no field army that could be trusted, and negotiation took the place of battle. Faced with the remark that this was not peace but a pact of servitude, the envoys of the Senate finally accepted terms of five thousand pounds of gold and thirty thousand pounds of silver in kind, together with a batch of hostages. The blockade lifted, Alaric withdrew towards northern Italy, besieged Rome again in 409 and set up a puppet emperor; only in the small hours of 24 August 410 did he strike simultaneously at several of the city gates, with Goths inside the city opening the way, and the sack followed for several days. Set against the card, the Assyrian doctrine of archers opening the way for the chariots belongs to the logic of the frontal breakthrough, while the siege of Italy in the fifth century is the logic of blockade and attrition. The bow's part lay mainly in harassment and plunder in the field; the siege itself was entrusted to ballistae and to hunger.
data: 可核對的數字集中在贖金與兵員兩端。公元四〇七年亞拉里克進軍到諾里庫姆，索要四千磅黃金，折算約一千八百一十四公斤，一羅馬磅約合零點四五三公斤；公元四〇八年九月羅馬之圍解開的代價則是五千磅黃金、三萬磅白銀、四千件絲質長衣、三千張染成猩紅色的獸皮，以及三千磅胡椒，亞拉里克另招募約四萬名獲釋的哥特奴隸充入軍中。亞拉里克本部的兵力，現代史家一般估在數萬之譜，常被引用者約三萬人，其中不少正是四〇八年才倒向他這一邊的聯隊與家屬。拜占庭皇帝狄奧多西二世在四一〇年派四千名援兵抵達拉文納，這批兵沒有扭轉攻勢。攻城本身歷時三日，自八月二十四日起算；羅馬全城人口一般估為四十萬至五十萬。地理上，糧食自非洲與西西里走海路到奧斯蒂亞港再轉陸路，港口與沿海道路因此是封鎖的關鍵點；從亞奎萊亞一線到羅馬的道路距離約六百至七百公里，而哥特人自山界走到城下只用了一個多月，說明其補給多靠擄掠。傷亡沒有可靠數字可查，真正流失的是軍隊：西羅馬在四〇七至四一一年間失去大批聯隊與稅源，這才是這場戰爭的耗損所在。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are concentrated in the ransoms and in the numbers of men. In AD 407 Alaric advanced into Noricum and demanded four thousand pounds of gold, roughly one thousand eight hundred and fourteen kilograms, a Roman pound being about 0.453 kilograms; the price of lifting the blockade of Rome in September 408 was five thousand pounds of gold, thirty thousand pounds of silver, four thousand silk tunics, three thousand hides dyed scarlet and three thousand pounds of pepper, and Alaric enrolled some forty thousand freed Gothic slaves into his army. The size of Alaric's own host is generally estimated by modern historians in the tens of thousands, the figure most often cited being about thirty thousand, a large part of them federate soldiers and dependants who had only come over to him in 408. The eastern emperor Theodosius II sent four thousand men to Ravenna in 410; they did not turn the tide. The sack itself lasted three days, counted from 24 August, and the population of the city is generally put at between four hundred thousand and five hundred thousand. Geographically the grain came from Africa and Sicily by sea to the harbour of Ostia and then by road, which made the harbour and the coastal road the key points of the blockade. The road distance from the line of Aquileia to Rome is of the order of six to seven hundred kilometres, while the Goths took a little over a month to march from the mountains to the walls, which tells us that their supply was largely plunder. There are no reliable casualty figures; what drained away was the army. Between 407 and 411 the Western Empire lost large numbers of federate troops and the tax revenue that paid for them, and that is where the real cost of this war lies.
cause: 第二次入侵的直接起因是羅馬自己的政變，遠因則是西羅馬用錢買退邊界的做法本身撐不住。公元四〇七年亞拉里克進軍到諾里庫姆，索要四千磅黃金，斯提里科照付；元老院裡有人當眾說這不是和平而是奴役的契約，斯提里科因此在皇帝面前失勢。公元四〇八年五月，東部皇帝阿卡狄烏斯去世，斯提里科打算讓亞拉里克率兵遠征高盧、並為自己另立局面；八月他在拉文納附近被奧利姆庇烏斯主持的宮廷政變殺死，聯軍的家屬隨即遭屠殺，這批人與原本的聯隊大批投向亞拉里克。朝廷既不肯給他「帝國伯」的名號，也不肯按時支付已經談妥的經費，亞拉里克退兵不成，決定用兵去取。他扶植的傀儡皇帝阿塔盧斯不肯安分，反而使非洲的糧源斷在羅馬自己手裡，把饑荒變成了武器。核心矛盾是：羅馬既無力在西邊重整野戰軍，又不肯承認亞拉里克作為國家軍事首長的地位與合法稅權，於是每一次買退，都只是把軍心與錢糧再送給對方一次。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the second invasion was a Roman coup d'état, while the remote cause was the unsustainable character of the Western Roman policy of buying off the frontier with money. In AD 407 Alaric advanced into Noricum and demanded four thousand pounds of gold, and Stilicho paid it. A senator remarked publicly that this was not peace but a pact of servitude, and Stilicho lost ground with the emperor as a result. In May 408 the eastern emperor Arcadius died; Stilicho intended to send Alaric into Gaul and to establish his own position, and in August he was killed in a court coup led by Olympius at Ravenna. The families of the federate troops were then massacred, and those men and their families went over in great numbers to Alaric. The court would neither give him the title of comes nor pay the subsidies already agreed; finding that he could not withdraw, Alaric resolved to take them by force. The puppet emperor he had raised, Attalus, would not stay in his place and instead let the grain of Africa be cut off by the Romans themselves, so that hunger itself became the weapon. The underlying contradiction was this: Rome had no strength to rebuild a field army in the west, and it would not acknowledge Alaric's standing as a national military leader with the right to levy taxes, so every payment bought off the enemy only by handing over the army's loyalty and the treasury's money a second time.
impact: 這場戰爭的後果超出意大利本身。羅馬第一次以帝國的名義向一支外來軍隊繳納如此規模的贖金，而且是用「以錢免戰」的做法換來不到兩年的喘息；公元四一〇年八月二十四日城破之後，西部帝國再沒有恢復對意大利的有效控制，皇權的象徵被打碎，皇位與軍權的分離則被固定下來。羅馬的糧食體系與稅基同時受損，城市人口在戰亂與饑荒中大量外流，西部帝國的財政愈發仰賴東方的匯款與臨時稅收，這條裂縫在五世紀上半葉迅速擴大為帝國崩潰。軍隊的組成也起了質變：亞拉里克要的從來不只是金錢，而是「帝國伯」的名號與徵稅權，也就是國家軍隊的合法性；他兩次被拒，等於被永久排除在羅馬體制之外，於是從受雇的邊境軍變成征服者。兵器史上的位置更為清楚：這場衝突是投射兵種衰落的註腳，羅馬守城靠弩砲而不是弓兵，亞述式的車上射手組合在五世紀初已隨羅馬車兵一併消失，弓的戰術位置從正面開路退到騎射與劫掠，短型複合反曲弓此後數百年成為歐亞草原的標準配備。
impactEn: The consequences of this war reached far beyond Italy. Rome paid for the first time, in the name of the empire, a ransom of that scale to a foreign army, and bought with it less than two years of respite. After 24 August 410 the Western Empire never regained effective control of Italy; the symbolism of imperial power was broken, and the separation of the throne from the army was fixed in place. The grain system and the tax base of Rome were damaged at the same time, the urban population fled the fighting and the famine in large numbers, and the finances of the western Empire came to lean even more heavily on eastern money transfers and expedients of taxation. The composition of the armies changed in kind as well. What Alaric wanted was never simply gold, but the title of comes and the right to levy taxes, that is, the legitimacy of a national army. Twice refused, he was permanently shut out of the Roman system and turned from an employed frontier force into a conqueror. The place of this conflict in the history of arms is even clearer: it is the record of the decline of the missile troops. Rome defended its walls with ballistae rather than with archers, the Assyrian combination of the shooting archer on the chariot had disappeared together with the Roman chariot troops at the beginning of the fifth century, and the bow's tactical place retreated from opening the way in the open field to mounted shooting and plunder, the short composite recurved bow remaining the standard equipment of the Eurasian steppe for centuries afterwards.
result: 結果分兩層。短期看，亞拉里克得手了：公元四〇八年九月羅馬遭到嚴密封鎖，飢荒面前元老院接受了巨額贖金與人質條件，圍解除去，亞拉里克帶著黃金退回北義大利；公元四〇九年他再圍羅馬，並另立普里斯庫斯·阿塔盧斯為皇帝，兩軍進抵拉文納，僵持之後他廢掉傀儡而重開談判；公元四一〇年八月二十四日拂曉攻破城門，連洗劫三日，羅馬的城牆第一次被非羅馬軍隊從內部攻破，來自伯勒尼基的修士耶柔米在寫給一位修女的信息中說，那座征服了整個世界的城市自己也被人用金錢買下了命，並且在刀劍之前先餓倒了。長期看，亞拉里克付出的代價更大：贖金壯大了他的軍隊，卻讓他坐實「不被帝國承認的首領」這個位置，公元四一〇年他企圖西進受阻，四一二年病死於科森扎的布森托河畔，聯軍隨後由阿陶爾夫接手，四一五年進入高盧，最終演成四二九年越過庇里牛斯山、五年後洗劫羅馬的另一支民族。而對西羅馬來說，這場戰爭是崩潰的起點而非終點：它證明了以宮廷政變處理邊防、用金錢代替兵力的做法，只會同時產生出被買退的敵人和被掏空的國家。
resultEn: The outcome has two layers. In the short term Alaric had his way. In September 408 Rome was sealed in by a strict blockade, and before the force of hunger the Senate accepted a ruinous ransom together with hostages; the blockade was lifted and Alaric withdrew north with his gold. In 409 he besieged Rome again and raised Priscus Attalus as emperor; the two armies moved as far as Ravenna, and after a stalemate he deposed the puppet and reopened negotiations. In the small hours of 24 August 410 the city gates were carried, and the sack ran for three days: the walls of Rome were breached for the first time from within by a non-Roman army, and Jerome, writing from Bethlehem to a nun, reported that the city which had taken the whole world had itself been bought off with gold and had fallen by famine before it fell to the sword. In the long term Alaric paid the greater price. The ransom enlarged his army but confirmed him in the position of a leader the empire would never acknowledge; his attempt to push west in 410 failed, and in 412 he died of illness by the Busento at Cosenza, his confederacy passing to Ataulf, who entered Gaul in 415 and became the other people who crossed the Pyrenees in 429 and sacked Rome five years later. For the Western Roman Empire, this war was the beginning of the collapse rather than its end. It demonstrated that handling the frontier by court coups and substituting money for troops produced, at one and the same time, an enemy bought off and a state hollowed out.
